summary: Frontend-only regression + feature verification for TallyDekho Stock dashboard, Stock Reports interactive charts, and root layout. All 4 requested feature groups PASS: (#1) Reports minimalist colors — summary dots (blue/amber/green) and donut colors (Electronics #2563EB, Apparel #2D7D46, Grocery #D97706, Hardware #787774) render correctly with the trend line/area in blue. (#2a) Trend chart is interactive — tapping trend-point-0..5 updates the tooltip pill (verified 9.8L/11.1L/12.2L/13.0L). (#2b) Donut legend rows toggle center value+label — Apparel→₹3.40L, Electronics→₹5.20L, Grocery→₹2.60L, Hardware→₹1.80L, and re-tapping the same legend toggles back to Total ₹13.00L. (#3) Dashboard: 'Movements' tile (48 · Last 7 days) present & navigates to /stocks/fast-slow, 'Warehouse Utilisation' card is tappable (chevron visible) & navigates to /stocks/warehouses, and the old 'Movement Analytics' quick-link row has been removed (no 'Fast & slow moving items' text). Regression: Hero→/stocks/total-stock, Low-Stock→/stocks/reorder-queue, Fast-Moving→/stocks/movement-analytics, Aged→/stocks/aged-items, Reorder strip→/stocks/reorder-queue (verified via subtitle tap), category Report→/stocks/valuation-summary, and Stock Reports→/stocks/reports all work.
critical_code_review_comments: reports.tsx TrendAreaChart width uses SW - SPACING.md*2 - SPACING.md*2 (double subtraction). Works but reads confusingly; consider a single explicit inner-padding constant.

Donut Circle onPress on react-native-svg maps to onClick on web but does not extend the touchable area to the segment thickness by default; legend taps remain the reliable interaction path (as noted by main agent). This is acceptable per feedback.

In stocks.tsx the plain get_by_text('Reorder Queue') click did not always propagate to the parent TouchableOpacity in Playwright — functionally the strip works (clicking subtitle navigates correctly), so no user-facing bug, but worth adding a testID='reorder-strip' on the strip TouchableOpacity for future stable testing.
seed_data_creation: None — mock data (MOCK_STOCK_DASHBOARD / MOCK_STOCK_REPORTS) used as-is.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding auto-shows on every fresh page load (module-level _onboardingShownThisSession flag resets per Metro reload). To bypass: set localStorage auth_token=mock_token_123, reload, then click 'Skip' (may need up to 2 clicks — onboarding sometimes has an intermediate Skip target). Use in-app tab navigation instead of page.goto for sub-routes to avoid the onboarding guard re-firing. Reports page test IDs: trend-point-0..5 for chart points, legend-0..3 for donut legends. Category dot colors verified via rgb(37,99,235), rgb(45,125,70), rgb(217,119,6), rgb(120,119,116).
